provisional_definition: A declared underlying state-transition-resource organization capable of supporting one or more implementations. It may be physical, computational, biological, hybrid, or abstract, but its level of description must be stated.
use_rule: Use only with a declared description level and dynamics.
not_to_be_confused_with: the mathematical carrier used to model it; a material label; consciousness.

provisional_definition: A family or class of substrates treated as sharing a declared implementation grammar or operational affordance.
use_rule: Use comparatively, with the shared grammar named.
not_to_be_confused_with: a single carrier token; an ontologically fundamental stuff.

provisional_definition: The typed state-bearing object on which a model’s dynamics, interfaces, resources, and package structures are defined. In the finite SBT setting this is often a finite state set plus declared structure.
not_to_be_confused_with: substrate in full physical detail; support; package.

provisional_definition: The full record `(id, X, H, D, U, interfaces, resources, admissibility)` used to type a carrier in this project.
use_rule: Preferred formal unit for cross-carrier comparison.

provisional_definition: One numerically distinct instance of a carrier specification or implementation.
not_to_be_confused_with: carrier type; structural equivalence; personal identity.

provisional_definition: An abstract class of carrier specifications sharing a declared signature.
not_to_be_confused_with: a theorem that all carrier tokens support equivalent realizations; A2.

provisional_definition: The components, states, channels, or region actually bearing a package at a time or along a route.
use_rule: Declare whether support is fixed, changing, overlapping, or distributed.
not_to_be_confused_with: the entire carrier; logical object; source-target lineage.

provisional_definition: A declared relation or map by which an abstract package specification is instantiated in carrier dynamics and interfaces.
use_rule: State domain, codomain, and preserved operations.

provisional_definition: A typed map/relation from abstract package components to carrier-level states, histories, operations, or invariants.
not_to_be_confused_with: identity map across carriers; proof of implementation correctness.

provisional_definition: Satisfaction by a carrier-indexed target of declared package clauses and coherence gates.
not_to_be_confused_with: phenomenal realization; source-target lineage; certificate soundness.

provisional_definition: A source/target pair that remains separately typed after renaming and cannot be reduced to one fixed-support construction without losing declared bridge/support/dynamics facts.
not_to_be_confused_with: different labels; different coordinates; a refinement on one frozen support.

provisional_definition: A construction in which the underlying support is held constant while descriptions, packages, protocols, or promoted layers change.
A typed tuple of structures, dynamics, interfaces, resources, clauses, and audits treated as one candidate higher-layer object.
not_to_be_confused_with: a single state; consciousness; certificate alone.

provisional_definition: The package instance declared on the source carrier at the relevant start history or interval.
not_to_be_confused_with: the source person; every source microstate.

provisional_definition: The candidate package instance declared on the target carrier at the relevant endpoint or interval.
not_to_be_confused_with: a guaranteed continuation; a public output copy.

provisional_definition: The design-level eight-clause consciousness-relevant closure package C1–C8 plus declared coherence/audit conditions from the attached consciousness work.
use_rule: Treat as a structural target and specify full vs simplified form.
not_to_be_confused_with: a proved sufficient condition for consciousness; an exhibited integrated instance.

provisional_definition: One declared requirement within a package, with its own carrier, evidence, temporal scope, and failure condition.
A declared completeness or fixed-point property relative to specified operations, continuations, interfaces, or audits.
use_rule: Name the operator and fixed-point notion.
not_to_be_confused_with: causal closure in every sense; phenomenal unity.

provisional_definition: An object defined as a fixed point, quotient, completion, or promoted survivor of a declared closure process.
not_to_be_confused_with: an object independent of carrier or route by definition.

provisional_definition: Controlled or endogenous persistence within a declared safe/feasible region under specified dynamics, actions, and resources.
use_rule: State kernel, horizon, and funding conditions.

provisional_definition: The greatest declared controlled-invariant safe set, or its project-specific analogue.
A package accepted at a higher description layer after declared sufficiency, closure, stability, honesty, and strictness gates.
not_to_be_confused_with: a package moved to a new carrier.

provisional_definition: The image of a package under a declared public/readout interface, possibly preserving outputs while discarding hidden or predictive organization.
not_to_be_confused_with: the full package; a counterfeit by ontological stipulation.

provisional_definition: A deliberately constructed target that matches selected public criteria while failing a named hidden, predictive, coherence, viability, or autonomy condition.
not_to_be_confused_with: a claim that the target is phenomenally nonconscious.

provisional_definition: A finite or otherwise auditable record of clause/gate satisfaction under declared interfaces and assumptions.
use_rule: Distinguish full C-package certificate and simplified schema.

provisional_definition: A theorem or assumption that certificate satisfaction is sufficient for the intended structural or ontological conclusion.
A declared check of a construction, map, defect, control, dependency, or gate whose scope and result are recorded.
use_rule: Audits can be analytic, computational, or mechanized.
not_to_be_confused_with: proof beyond the checked scope; empirical validation.

provisional_definition: A named audit condition required before a claim or package receives a declared status.
A predicate defining which states, histories, actions, bridges, routes, observations, or interventions are allowed in a claim.
not_to_be_confused_with: physical possibility in general; viability; certificate satisfaction.

provisional_definition: The condition that a claimed package or effect is not manufactured solely by an undeclared representation, scheduling, decoder, or comparison protocol.
use_rule: Test by protocol controls and removal interventions.

provisional_definition: Typed data relating source and target carriers, states, histories, packages, or processes, together with admissibility and compatibility obligations.
use_rule: Always name bridge form and direction.

provisional_definition: An ordered sequence or coupled process of bridge stages connecting declared source and target conditions.
not_to_be_confused_with: a single bridge; a route-independent connection.

provisional_definition: A declared interval/event in which responsibility for maintaining specified package functions shifts from source-side to target-side support.
use_rule: Define start, completion, and success criterion.
not_to_be_confused_with: source destruction; lineage; an instantaneous state map.

provisional_definition: A nonempty interval or region in which source and target supports jointly contribute to the declared package or bridge.
A representation change preserving named structures or observables between typed domains.
use_rule: State what is translated and lost.

provisional_definition: A satisfied typed preservation relation for a named object/invariant under a declared bridge or route.
use_rule: Use only after specifying object, bridge, and defect.
not_to_be_confused_with: movement of a subject; target realization; lineage.

provisional_definition: Informal protocol term for changing the support/carrier of an implementation over time.
use_rule: Translate into bridge, route, handoff, transport, and autonomy predicates.

provisional_definition: Project-level informal umbrella for continuation beyond one substrate/medium.
use_rule: Forbidden as a primitive; decompose into tagged predicates.
not_to_be_confused_with: a theorem, mechanism, or ontological fact.

provisional_definition: A verdict assigned by an explicit lineage criterion to a source-target history pair.
use_rule: Never define by “the same continuing subject.”

provisional_definition: Equality/equivalence of outcomes for all admissible routes with common endpoints under a declared comparison relation.
use_rule: Requires a theorem, often flatness/confluence-like conditions.

provisional_definition: A difference in declared outcome/invariant/lineage across admissible routes with common endpoints.
use_rule: Name the differing observable or predictive structure.

provisional_definition: The nontrivial action accumulated around a closed route/loop despite endpoint-level current agreement.
not_to_be_confused_with: any path dependence; entropy production; trauma.

provisional_definition: A typed operation combining bridges, transports, or lineage relations with stated domain/codomain and defect law.
A point in a declared carrier at one model time or stage.
An admissible ordered record of states/actions/events on a carrier or coupled route.
A dynamics-bearing evolution or coupling, not merely a sequence of endpoint states.
use_rule: Use when causal generation or overlap matters.

provisional_definition: The declared family of current observations, reports, readouts, or controls available at a specified boundary.
not_to_be_confused_with: all behavior; all empirically accessible information; full state.

provisional_definition: The declared admissible continuations and future observation family used to distinguish histories/states predictively.
use_rule: May be richer than the public interface.
not_to_be_confused_with: omniscient future access; current report interface.

provisional_definition: A map from carrier states/histories to a declared observable value space.
not_to_be_confused_with: the thing observed; a complete description.

provisional_definition: Equivalence classes induced by agreement on declared current/public observations.
Equivalence classes induced by agreement under all declared admissible future continuations and observations.
not_to_be_confused_with: phenomenal state; cross-carrier lineage by itself.

provisional_definition: A variable or distinction not determined by a declared interface, possibly still measurable through another interface.
Factorization of a determining variable through a declared interface, making it recoverable at that interface.
not_to_be_confused_with: visibility to every observer; loss of consciousness.

provisional_definition: Agreement of declared future behavior under all admitted continuations.
use_rule: Scope to continuation family and horizon.
not_to_be_confused_with: full package preservation; lineage; causal history.

provisional_definition: Agreement at a declared public interface over a declared intervention/horizon set.
use_rule: Use as one observable relation only.

provisional_definition: An overloaded term that is invalid unqualified in this project. It must be replaced by token identity, structural equivalence, predictive equivalence, or a declared lineage relation.
Numerical identity of one declared object token through a formal identity rule.
Equivalence or isomorphism with respect to a named structure family.
A directed, history-sensitive relation connecting package instances under a declared criterion; it may be one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one, partial, or route-dependent.
not_to_be_confused_with: equivalence relation; endpoint matching; genetic lineage by analogy.

provisional_definition: A target package related forward to a source by a declared lineage criterion.
not_to_be_confused_with: the unique continuation; child copy; conscious subject.

provisional_definition: One of two or more numerically distinct target instances that are equivalent under specified source-relative criteria.
not_to_be_confused_with: a nonreal target; a unique successor.

provisional_definition: Informal term for a target constructed to match named source information.
use_rule: Replace with exact copied object and relation.

provisional_definition: One member of a one-to-many lineage outcome under a declared criterion.
use_rule: State branch relation and shared ancestry.
not_to_be_confused_with: unique identity continuation; mere computational fork.

provisional_definition: A route/outcome in which one source has multiple target successors under a declared lineage relation.
not_to_be_confused_with: proof that all branches are one token.

provisional_definition: A route/outcome in which one target has multiple source predecessors under a declared lineage relation.
use_rule: State what ancestral structures combine or conflict.

provisional_definition: The absence of an admissible target successor under a declared lineage criterion.
not_to_be_confused_with: metaphysical annihilation; empty viability kernel alone.

provisional_definition: Loss of the structural conditions supporting a package or lineage relation on a carrier.
not_to_be_confused_with: ontological death without an O premise.

provisional_definition: An interval with no active target-package realization while some recovery-relevant record or potential remains.
use_rule: Specify what persists and recovery conditions.

provisional_definition: Creation of a target package from retained records after disruption or absence.
use_rule: Classify as repair, recreation, or underdetermined under `κ`.

provisional_definition: A protocol in which the source package/support is deliberately disabled, overwritten, or made unavailable by a declared stage.
use_rule: State timing and what is destroyed.

provisional_definition: A protocol in which the source remains available after target construction/handoff.
A route with staged support replacement or contribution change over a nontrivial interval.
A route modeled without an overlap interval or with a single declared transition stage.
A route admitting a declared inverse up to a named equivalence and admissibility domain.
not_to_be_confused_with: token identity; zero entropy; route independence.

provisional_definition: A package structurally instantiated across multiple supports/components/carriers whose joint organization is required.
A target that maintains specified package predicates under target-endogenous dynamics after a declared removal intervention for a horizon or closure condition.
A target whose relevant package predicates fail when the bridge, source, decoder, or protocol support is removed.
A target whose claimed structure exists only after applying a continuing external decoding/reconstruction map.
Zero defect for a named structure under a declared equality/commuting/isomorphism criterion.
A named defect remains within a declared threshold over a stated domain and horizon.
use_rule: Declare metric, threshold, and composition law.

provisional_definition: A typed measure or witness of failure of a specific factorization, commutation, closure, invariance, or matching condition.
The mismatch remaining after an allowed fit, projection, repair, or optimization.
not_to_be_confused_with: defect in every sense; unexplained essence.

provisional_definition: An operation that reduces a named defect, restores admissibility, or returns a package to a declared region.
use_rule: State whether continuity through repair is separately tracked.
not_to_be_confused_with: proof that nothing was destroyed or recreated.

provisional_definition: Persistence of a stated property under a declared perturbation family and bound.
A scalar or relation measuring agreement with a named source object under a declared metric/test family.
use_rule: Use only as one quality measure.

provisional_definition: A proposed mapping from structural objects/audits to empirical or familiar cognitive/phenomenal categories.
A conditional implication from structural predicates to a claim about what their satisfaction is, under named assumptions.
The premise that a declared certificate adequately captures the intended structural target.
use_rule: Keep separate from A1 and A2.

provisional_definition: The attached work’s named ontological postulate that lawful audited closure, under the priced conditions, is realization rather than mere imitation.
The attached work’s named postulate that carrier labels do not add an extra ontological law once the relevant structure is realized.
use_rule: No carrier-transport/invariance theorem is currently supplied by polymorphism alone.
not_to_be_confused_with: cross-carrier transport; implementation equivalence; empirical substrate neutrality.

provisional_definition: An ontological/phenomenal category not used as a primitive in structural definitions in this exploration.
use_rule: Use only in project motivation, recognition hypotheses, or O claims.

provisional_definition: An ontologically loaded bearer of consciousness; structurally, replace with package instance, lineage node, or target candidate unless an O claim is intended.
The O-level claim that a structurally realized package is an instance of consciousness.
A system’s reproduction of selected dynamics or outputs under a declared relation.
not_to_be_confused_with: nonrealization by definition; realization by definition.

provisional_definition: A prohibited bare comparator. It must be expanded into a typed relation and scope.
use_rule: Use only as “same under relation R with respect to F.”

provisional_definition: A prohibited bare success verb. It must name the object, bridge, equivalence/metric, domain, and horizon.
